backend/main.mo: Main Motoko actor defining NFT light art piece storage, user profiles, and access-controlled endpoints for artwork upload (admin-only), public browsing, and profile management with Internet Identity integration.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report documenting three implemented features: subtitle text styling improvements, Walter Russell quote addition, and prominent NFT notice banner, all with high confidence.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: JSON-formatted summaries of all frontend TypeScript/React files covering routing, pages, components, hooks, and styling configuration.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind CSS base styles with custom CSS variables defining light and dark theme color palettes using OKLCH color space for consistent design tokens.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point with root div and module script reference to main.tsx for the Lichtkunst application.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root React component configuring TanStack Router with routes for gallery, artwork detail, and upload pages, wrapped in ThemeProvider and Layout with Toaster for notifications.
frontend/src/components/ArtworkCard.tsx: Gallery card component displaying artwork thumbnail with hover effects, NFT badge, title, and description, navigating to detail page on click.
frontend/src/components/Layout.tsx: Main layout wrapper with sticky header (logo, navigation, login button), prominent German NFT notice banner with sparkle icons, main content area, profile setup modal, and footer with caffeine.ai attribution.
frontend/src/components/LoginButton.tsx: Internet Identity authentication button handling login/logout with loading states, error handling, and query cache clearing on logout.
frontend/src/components/Navigation.tsx: Navigation component with Home and Upload (admin-only) buttons, highlighting active route and checking admin permissions.
frontend/src/components/NFTBadge.tsx: Small badge component displaying 'NFT' label with sparkle icon for artwork cards.
frontend/src/components/NFTInfo.tsx: Detailed NFT information card showing token ID, minting date, ICP badge, and blockchain storage description for artwork detail pages.
frontend/src/components/ProfileSetupModa: Modal dialog that prompts authenticated users without a profile to enter their name, using Internet Identity authentication and profile hooks to save the user profile.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: React Query hook that creates and manages the backend actor instance, handling authentication state changes and initializing access control with an optional admin token from URL parameters.
frontend/src/hooks/useGetAllArtworks.ts: React Query hook that fetches all artworks from the backend actor, returning an array of LightArtPiece objects.
frontend/src/hooks/useGetArtwork.ts: React Query hook that fetches a single artwork by ID from the backend actor, returning a LightArtPiece or null.
frontend/src/hooks/useGetCallerUserProfi: React Query hook that fetches the current authenticated user's profile, returning UserProfile or null with loading and fetch states.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: React context provider and hook for Internet Identity authentication, managing login state, identity persistence, and providing login/logout functionality with configurable AuthClient options.
frontend/src/hooks/useIsCallerAdmin.ts: React Query hook that checks if the current authenticated user has admin privileges by calling the backend actor.
frontend/src/hooks/useSaveCallerUserProf: React Query mutation hook that saves the current user's profile and invalidates the profile query cache on success.
frontend/src/hooks/useUploadArtwork.ts: React Query mutation hook that uploads artwork with file, title, and description to the backend using ExternalBlob, supporting upload progress callbacks and invalidating the artworks cache on success.
frontend/src/index.css: Tailwind CSS configuration with custom color variables for light and dark themes using a warm, luminous palette inspired by light art, plus font imports for Playfair Display and Inter.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that sets up React Query and Internet Identity providers, then renders the App component into the root DOM element.
frontend/src/pages/ArtworkDetail.tsx: Page component that displays a single artwork's details in a two-column layout with image and metadata, including NFT information and navigation back to the gallery.
frontend/src/pages/Gallery.tsx: Main gallery page with hero section, Walter Russell quote, and grid display of all artworks using ArtworkCard components, with loading and error states.
frontend/src/pages/Upload.tsx: React component for uploading artwork with title, description, and image file; includes admin authentication checks, file handling, progress tracking, and automatic NFT minting on successful upload.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility functions for extracting and managing URL parameters from both query strings and hash-based routing, with sessionStorage persistence support for maintaining state across navigation.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration defining custom color schemes using OKLCH color space, typography with Inter and Playfair Display fonts, animations, and extended theme utilities for the light art portfolio design system.
project_state.json: Project metadata documenting a light art portfolio website with ICP blockchain NFT minting, listing architectural decisions, known issues (subtitle contrast, incomplete NFT implementation), and existing features including upload interface and Internet Identity authentication.
